summary.note: usage measured through the claude CLI: tools disabled, thinking off, shader SYSTEM prompt only; the CLI adds roughly 200 tokens of its own framing per call to input_tokens that the app's driver would not send

items.description: a smooth wash that fades between my colours
a chase that runs along the roofline
everything pulsing to a steady beat
a spinning tunnel you fly into
alternating flashes between my first two colours
green streaks falling like digital rain
a comet circling with a long tail
random sparkles over a solid colour
a two colour checkerboard sliding sideways
a sunrise slowly rising from the bottom
